documentBlocks.content: DIRECTIVE FROM THE NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL

DATE: 24 JUNE 2026
TO: COMMANDING OFFICER
FROM: OFFICE OF THE NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISOR
SUBJECT: SPECIAL APPOINTMENT ORDER

Following a review of your record and operational readiness, this office has approved your appointment to the Strategic Response Program. You should join this command within 4 months of receiving this order. Failure to report within the stated window will require written clearance from headquarters.
